profile.headline: Fullstack Software Engineer | React | TypeScript | Node.js
profile.summary:
Hello! I'm a software engineer specializing in React, Typescript, Express, and more. I have experience building scalable web applications with tools like AWS(EC2, RDS, DocDB) and testing libraries like Jest to name a few.
Currently, I'm building applications with Next.js, utilizing SSR and Next's powerful cache system. You can see projects I've done and am working on here - https://github.com/stevkim

🧗‍♂️ Beyond Coding:
Away from the computer, you'll often find me rock climbing! Much like programming, climbing is like a puzzle to be solved, requiring optimizations of body positions and movements to 'solve' the climb. The excitement of dedicating myself to 'solve' problems is an integral part of my continuous growth.

🥋 Martial Arts Background:
Before my transition into tech, I spend a decade as a martial arts instructor. This is were I developed my discipline and resilience that is reflected in my work today! I accredit a lot of who I am to the values I learned while teaching the art for the many years. 

🔗 Let's Connect:
Excited to connect with tech enthusiasts and mentors! Whether it's tech trends or climbing stories, let's chat and build connections beyond the screen.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
‣ Collaborated with a team to design and develop a modern web application, successfully replacing an outdated, non-functional system for over 100,000 users
‣ Developed backend infrastructure with Node.js and AWS, leveraging AWS EventBridge for automated scheduling and AWS SQS to handle asynchronous workflows
‣ Implemented a data migration strategy on AWS, synchronizing existing data systems with the new application to ensure minimal downtime and data integrity across platforms
‣ Created high-performance applications using Serverless Architecture and Next.js static exports, reducing page load times by 30% and maintenance costs by 40%
‣ Promoted code quality through code reviews, pair programming, and agile methodologies, fostering a collaborative development environment
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · TypeScript · Jest · React.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Support Software Engineer
positions.description:
Utilizing my knowledge of the software development cycle, I conducted code reviews/provided technical guidance for engineers in React, Javascript, Node.js, and more on a daily basis. I'd advise in best practices and help debug when necessary.

‣ Provided technical guidance for debugging and improving full-stack software, receiving a 4.9/5 feedback rating for fostering confidence and clear communication
‣ Advised 25 engineers on optimizing development processes through workflows and design patterns during one-on-one office hours and workshops
‣ Taught Javascript and React fundamentals to improve overall comprehension and practical application skills, evidenced by elevated project completion rates and ongoing assessments
positions.insights: Skills: MongoDB · Data Structures · Express.js · Node.js · Back-End Web Development · Mongoose ODM · JavaScript · Debugging · SQL · React.js · Computer Engineering · Front-End Development · Problem Solving · Attention to Detail · Programming · Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP)

positions.title: parKing
positions.description:
Built with - React, Redux, TailwindCSS, React-Router, Supabase, Node, Express
https://github.com/pokemon-parKing
A SaaS application to optimize car parking and valet interactions.

‣ Designed the state management system using Redux, reducing redundant API calls by 20% and augmenting state predictability.
‣ Led the integration of features to elevate the fluidity of the application, leveraging React-Router for navigation and redirects.
‣ Enhanced user experience through polished interfaces using the DaisyUI library and a map view using the Google Maps API.
‣ Utilized Supabase OAuth for secure authentication, enhancing user access controls and ensuring reliable authentication processes.

positions.title: WebCountry
positions.description:
Built with - React, MongoDB, Redux, React-Router, Puppeteer
https://github.com/stevkim/scraper
A web-scraping application for products on Backcountry.com that tracks price trends over time.

‣ Developed a data synchronization module for automated reporting of item information at 12-hour intervals
‣ Maximized website performance via strategic code splitting, achieving a 100% Lighthouse rating and faster loading times for improved user experience
‣ Implemented interactive line charts to enhance user engagement by providing dynamic insights through data visualizations

positions.title: Atelier
positions.description:
Frontend - React, CSS3, Jest
Backend - Node, Express, Mongodb
Deployment - AWS(EC2), Nginx for load-balancing
An engaging ecommerce landing page showcasing a curated selection of products.

Front-End - https://github.com/Revenge-of-the-SithQL
‣ Optimized app efficiency with React memoization, reducing re-renders by 30% and cutting page response times from 2 seconds to under 1 second.
‣ Improved the performance of an infinite scroll feature by implementing a throttle function to maintain page responsiveness.
‣ Engineered an algorithm that converts image files to be stored as base64 strings using Node.js’ FileReader

Back-End - https://github.com/hr-titan/sk-reviews
‣ Managed a throughput of 3000 responses per second with 0% error rates across five AWS EC2 instances.
‣ Utilized the round-robin load-balancing technique with NGINX for fluid horizontal scaling.
‣ Designed and implemented a background service reducing queries by 80% and cutting query times from 2 seconds to 40 milliseconds.
